description: This file defines tracing categories, message formatting functions, and classes related to tracing and logging within the Thunder namespace, specifically for the Trace sub-namespace. It includes category definitions, utility classes for message categories, and timing-based duration logging.

classes.name: Constructor
classes.description: Represents a trace message for constructor calls, providing access to the message text and length.

classes.name: CopyConstructor
classes.description: Represents a trace message for copy constructor calls, providing access to the message text and length.

classes.name: AssignmentOperator
classes.description: Represents a trace message for assignment operator calls, providing access to the message text and length.

classes.name: Destructor
classes.description: Represents a trace message for destructor calls, providing access to the message text and length.

classes.name: MethodEntry
classes.description: Represents a trace message indicating entry into a method.

classes.name: MethodExit
classes.description: Represents a trace message indicating exit from a method.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Represents a duration trace message, measuring elapsed time between start and end points.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Backwards compatible formatting functions for strings with variadic arguments.

methods.name: Constructor
methods.description: Initializes a trace message for constructor calls with a static text.

methods.name: CopyConstructor
methods.description: Initializes a trace message for copy constructor calls with a static text.

methods.name: AssignmentOperator
methods.description: Initializes a trace message for assignment operator calls with a static text.

methods.name: Destructor
methods.description: Initializes a trace message for destructor calls with a static text.

methods.name: MethodEntry
methods.description: Constructs a trace message indicating method entry.

methods.name: MethodExit
methods.description: Constructs a trace message indicating method exit.

methods.name: Duration
methods.description: Constructs a duration trace message based on start time and optional formatter.
